installation.placement: Shared HTML template, near closing body; last executable body script, followed only by inert page JSON in generated pages. Outside React root, without an effect or navigation loader.

installation.duplicateHandling: One tag per document. State changes, dialogs, bookmarks and same-document anchors do not inject another. Full document navigation loads one tag in the new page.

installation.otherAds: All five banner formats and placement/queue configuration unchanged. Google AdSense single loader/account meta/ads.txt preserved. Popunder remains disabled. Analytics retains its independent consent gate.

preservation.preserved: Article text/images, translations, full metadata/canonical/hreflang/JSON-LD, CSS, hydrationdata, JS, sitemap,robots,ads.txt,security/cache headers and current banner placements.

browserFixtures.scope: Nine Social Bar desktop/mobile/tablet cases, six existing performance cases, two AdSense cases and22banner cases. Mocked provider responses used for functional tests only. Covers once-per-document load, state changes, hash links, full navigation, reload, language selection, menu/dialog keyboard behavior, overflow, banner document.write/storage/serialization/errors and disabled popunder.
browserFixtures.reruns: One new mobile assertion was corrected to address the menu button by its stable aria-controls after its label changes on opening. publicHTTP.scope: Public route text, metadata/schema/canonical/hreflang, style/page data and resource bytes match the tested release. Every sampled page contains the exact original tag once. Sitemap,robots.txt,ads.txt and cache/security headers verified.

validation.visual: Actual production screenshots at1440x1000,1024x1366and390x844 inspected. Existing site layout preserved. No identifiable Social Bar creative visible in the captured checks; 15-second follow-up received an empty bootstrap.

directHTTPS.method: Normal managed HTTPS proxy, TLS verification enabled; no alternate domain, address or browser-control bypass.

providerResult.publisherBrowser: Real ordinary browser visits to public FansGTA returned HTTP200 for the original bootstrap, one request per document, no certificate errors, no CSP violations, no JavaScript exceptions. No provider interception or alternate domain.
providerResult.interpretation: Script presence and successful HTTP status do not prove a visible ad. An empty JavaScript response cannot initialize the Social Bar on this observed visit. Reason for the empty response is unknown; no claim of account inactivity, universal provider failure, creative fill, impressions or revenue.
providerResult.remainingAction: If no Social Bar appears in the owner’s normal browser, ask Adsterra to verify this exact unit for fansgta.com and investigate the empty bootstrap response. No account-side access was available here. No credentials requested.

temporaryCloudBrowser.scope: Only the task-owned profile Custom ServerCertificate database; OS/shared NSS/PC/site security and proxy policy unchanged. No ignore-certificate-errors flags.

noOtherChanges: No published article, image, translation, link, SEO field, sitemap or editorial schedule edited by the Social Bar change. No ad clicks performed, SDK behavior/frequency altered or additional format installed.
